modern: Does the sun take on the work of the rain, or Aesculapius the work of the Fruit-bearer, the earth? And how is it with each of the stars—are they not different, and yet they work together to the same end?
original: Does the sun undertake to do the work of the rain, or Aesculapius the work of the Fruit-bearer [the earth]? And how is it with respect to each of the stars—are they not different and yet they work together to the same end?
